name: side-notes
description: Every few steps a side check looks for one thing you may have missed and shows it as a short note above the prompt.

check_every.title: Check every N steps
check_every.description: How many main-agent steps between two side checks. Default 6. /side-notes every <n> wins over this.

run_in_terminal.title: Also run in the terminal
run_in_terminal.description: Run the side check in terminal sessions too. Off by default: the mod is meant for the desktop app and the phone.

undo_minutes.title: Undo window (minutes)
undo_minutes.description: How long an answer to a note (Knew it, Dismiss, Learn more, Chat about it, or 1/2/3 on the phone) can be taken back. Default 5. 0 turns undo off.
